native_mechanisms: Two knot-cords laid crosswise over a sand-tray mark every place their symbols meet (a lattice of symbol-pair crossings).

A single one-cell ink-worm walks the eight winds and curls back over its own trail to re-test a junction from another face, keeping no ledger but the sand mounds, finishing only when no junction anywhere can still be improved.
The worm crosses a furrow sideways spending no sand, letting one cord slip a step ahead of the other (a free lateral move as the one permitted stumble).
core_technique: Banded Needleman-Wunsch with a heuristic lower-bound-derived bandwidth, two rolling rows, and an AVX2 diagonal-band kernel whose horizontal-gap pass is a tilted-coordinate prefix-maximum (scan) with scalar block-carry threading.
